<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">5.11&#8195;&#8194;<U>Additional Avidity Platform Technology</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">5.11.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>Evaluation of Additional Avidity Platform Technology</U>. During the Research Term, Avidity shall
promptly (and in all cases no later than [***]) notify the JSC in writing of the existence of any proposed Additional Avidity Platform Technology that has not been previously disclosed to BMS under this Agreement (each such notice, an
&#8220;<U>Avidity Additional Platform IP Notification</U>&#8221;). Each Avidity Additional Platform IP Notification shall (a)&nbsp;describe (i) the applicable <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> in reasonable detail, including whether
any such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> is licensed to Avidity by a Third Party, and (ii)&nbsp;any Third Party Intellectual Property Rights known to Avidity that may be necessary to practice such
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> and (b)&nbsp;disclose any Patent owned or controlled by Avidity or its Affiliates claiming such proposed Additional Avidity Platform Technology. The JSC shall discuss and review such Avidity
Additional Platform IP Notification, and BMS, in its sole discretion, may decline to have any such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> (and such Patents to the extent claiming such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How)</FONT>
included as Avidity <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> and Avidity Patents under this Agreement by providing Avidity with written notice of such determination within [***] of receiving such Avidity Additional Platform IP Notification,
in which case such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> and Patents (to the extent declined by BMS) will be excluded from the definitions of Avidity Patents, Avidity <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> and Licensed IP. If
BMS does not so decline to have any such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> or Patent included as Avidity <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> or an Avidity Patent under this Agreement, the JSC shall promptly notify the IP
Committee of such Avidity Additional Platform IP Notification. The IP Committee shall discuss and review such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> and Patents[***] then such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> shall be
deemed to be &#8220;Additional Avidity Platform Technology&#8221; for purposes of this Agreement (subject to Section&nbsp;5.11.3 (BMS Decline of Additional Avidity Platform Technology)). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">5.11.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Disputes</U>.[***] then BMS will, within [***] of the IP Committee&#8217;s receipt of the applicable
Avidity Additional Platform IP notification, in its sole discretion, either (a)&nbsp;decline to have any such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> or Patent included under this Agreement by providing Avidity with written notice of such
determination (in which case such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> and Patents will be excluded from the definitions of Avidity Patents, Avidity <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How,</FONT> and Licensed IP) or (b) [***]. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">5.11.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>BMS Decline of Additional Avidity Platform Technology</U>. [***] BMS may, in its sole discretion,
nonetheless decline to have any such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> included as Additional Avidity Platform Technology under this Agreement by providing Avidity with written notice of such determination within [***] of receiving
such Avidity Additional Platform IP Notification [***]. If BMS provides Avidity with such written notice within such applicable period, then such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> will not become Additional Avidity Platform Technology
under this Agreement, and instead such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> and Patents to the extent claiming such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> will be excluded from the definitions of Avidity Patents, Avidity <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How,</FONT> and Licensed IP [***]. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">5.11.4&#8195;&#8194;<U>Records</U>. The IP Committee shall keep a running
list of all Additional Avidity Platform Technology. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">ARTICLE 6. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><U>FURTHER DEVELOPMENT, REGULATORY, MANUFACTURING, AND COMMERCIALIZATION OF LICENSED PRODUCTS </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>Development</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.1.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>General</U>. Except for the Research Collaboration Activities allocated to Avidity under a Research
Plan, BMS (and its Affiliates), either itself or with or through Third Party(ies), shall have the sole right to Develop (and shall control all aspects of the Development of) Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products in the Field in the Territory. For
the avoidance of doubt, during the applicable Research Term, BMS shall not conduct any research activities with respect to Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products outside of the Research Plan applicable to such Licensed Compounds and Licensed
Products. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.1.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Diligence</U>. Subject to Avidity&#8217;s compliance with this Agreement, including the
performance of the Research Collaboration Activities allocated to Avidity, on a Licensed <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Target-by-Licensed</FONT></FONT> Target basis, BMS (itself or with or through its Affiliates
or Third Parties) shall use Commercially Reasonable Efforts to Develop, and to seek Regulatory Approval for, at least one Licensed Product Directed to such Licensed Target in the U.S. and at least one of the Other Major Markets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.1.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>Assistance by Avidity</U>. Subject to Section&nbsp;6.4.3 (Cost of Manufacturing Technology Transfer), to
the extent not otherwise set forth in this Agreement or in a Research Plan, at the reasonable request of BMS, Avidity shall consult with BMS with respect to, and provide reasonable assistance (including technical assistance) to BMS in connection
with, BMS&#8217;s Development (including manufacturing process development) and Manufacture of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Regulatory</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.2.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>Regulatory Activities</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:16%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a)&#8195;&#8194;BMS (or its Affiliates or other designees) shall have the sole right to (i)&nbsp;prepare, obtain, and
maintain INDs, Drug Approval Applications, Regulatory Approvals and other regulatory submissions and applications for Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products (including as a single agent, for combination use or otherwise) in the Field in the
Territory (including the setting of the overall regulatory strategy therefor), and (ii)&nbsp;conduct communications with Regulatory Authorities for Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products (including as a single agent, for combination use or
otherwise) in the Field in the Territory. Without limiting Avidity&#8217;s obligations set forth in a Research Plan, Avidity shall provide support and assistance to BMS, as may be reasonably requested by BMS and subject to Section&nbsp;7.12 (Cost of
Avidity Support Services), in preparing, obtaining and maintaining INDs, Drug Approval Applications and Regulatory Approvals for Licensed Products, and in the activities in support thereof, including (A)&nbsp;providing documents or other materials
required by Applicable Law or requested by a Regulatory Authority, (B)&nbsp;otherwise assisting BMS with preparing such Regulatory Documentation and answering questions from Regulatory Authorities (including, if requested by BMS, attending meetings
with Regulatory Authorities), (C) filing (or using Commercially Reasonable Efforts to cause its contract manufacturers to file) regulatory documentation with Regulatory Authorities such that such documentation may be referenced in Regulatory
Documentation submitted by BMS (or its Affiliates or other designees) for Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products if applicable, and (D)&nbsp;providing (and using Commercially Reasonable Efforts to cause its contract manufacturers to provided) CMC
and other Manufacturing-related information and assistance. As between the Parties, all Regulatory Documentation (including all Regulatory Approvals) for any Licensed Compound or Licensed Product shall be owned by, and shall be the sole property and
held in the name of, BMS (or its Affiliate or other designee). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">32 </P>

</DIV></Center>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:16%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b)&#8195;&#8194;Without limiting the foregoing, at no cost to BMS
(i)&nbsp;reasonably in advance of any preparation of an IND submission for Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products by BMS, the Parties will meet to discuss the information to be included in such IND submission that specifically relates to the
Avidity AOC Platform Technology, and Avidity will provide such information in its Control that it believes to be useful, and (ii)&nbsp;prior to any IND submissions for Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products by BMS, to the extent such IND
submissions specifically relates to the Avidity AOC Platform Technology, BMS shall provide Avidity a draft copy of the portions of such IND that specifically relate to the Avidity AOC Platform Technology to allow Avidity to review to ensure
consistency of language and information previously known to Regulatory Authorities regarding the Avidity AOC Platform Technology, and BMS shall reasonably consider any comments provided by Avidity within [***] of Avidity&#8217;s receipt of such
draft copy that specifically relate to the Avidity AOC Platform Technology, and BMS will also provide Avidity with a final copy of the portion of such IND submissions that specifically relate to the Avidity AOC Platform Technology as filed with the
Regulatory Authority. For clarity, in no event shall the foregoing discussions, support, and assistance provided by Avidity be subject to Section&nbsp;7.12 (Cost of Avidity Support Services). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:16%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(c)&#8195;&#8194;In addition, prior to any submission of regulatory documentation relating to the Avidity AOC Platform
Technology by Avidity, to the extent such submissions specifically relates to any Licensed Compound or Licensed Product, Avidity shall provide BMS a draft copy of such documentation to allow BMS to review to ensure consistency of language and
information previously known to Regulatory Authorities regarding the Licensed Compound or Licensed Product, and Avidity shall consider any comments timely provided by BMS in good faith; <I>provided </I>that (x)&nbsp;Avidity may redact any
information that is not specifically related to the Licensed Compound or Licensed Product and (y)&nbsp;Avidity will not have to provide BMS with any regulatory documentation, information or materials related to a compound or product being Developed
or Commercialized by a Third Party licensee of Avidity. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.2.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Interactions with Regulatory
Authorities</U>. As between the Parties, BMS (or its Affiliates or other designees) shall have the sole right to communicate and otherwise interact with Regulatory Authorities with respect to any Licensed Compound or Licensed Product, including with
respect to any INDs, Drug Approval Applications and other Regulatory Approvals in connection therewith. Except to the extent required by Applicable Law (in which case Avidity shall notify BMS of such legal requirement in writing and shall, to the
extent permitted by Applicable Law, consult with, and follow the reasonable direction of BMS in making the filings or otherwise interacting with Regulatory Authorities), Avidity (and its Affiliates) shall have no right to, and shall not, make any
regulatory filings related to any Licensed Compound or Licensed Product or otherwise interact with any Regulatory Authorities with respect to any Licensed Compound or Licensed Product; <I>provided</I> that as and to the extent reasonably requested
by BMS in writing, Avidity shall interact with Regulatory Authorities (including making such regulatory filings and performing such other regulatory functions) in connection with Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.2.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>Global Safety Database; Pharmacovigilance</U>. BMS (itself or through its designee) shall be responsible
for establishing, holding and maintaining the global safety database for any Licensed Product with respect to information on adverse events concerning any Licensed Product, as and to the extent required by Applicable Law. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.2.4&#8195;&#8194;<U>Safety Information Exchange</U>. Prior to the first Licensed Product entering clinical Development, the
Parties will negotiate in good faith and agree on processes and procedures for sharing safety information and ensuring compliance with reporting requirements to Regulatory Authorities relating to Licensed Products. The agreed upon processes and
procedures will be set forth in a pharmacovigilance agreement containing mutually agreed terms and conditions that are customary for agreements of this type. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>Manufacture</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.3.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>Supply of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products</U>. BMS (and its Affiliates), either itself or with
or through Third Party(ies), shall have the sole right to Manufacture (and shall control all aspects of the Manufacturing of) Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products for use in the Field in the Territory (including for use in Clinical Trials)
subject to the terms of this Agreement, and for clarity, except as specifically required pursuant to and in accordance with Section&nbsp;6.3.2 (Supply of Licensed </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">33 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">Compounds and Licensed Products), Avidity (and its Affiliates) shall have no right to do so.
For clarity, at all times during the Term, BMS shall have the right to conduct applicable <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-Manufacturing</FONT> activities (including Developing the Manufacturing process), together with any Third Party with
respect to such Licensed Compound or Licensed Product. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.3.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Supply of Licensed Compounds and Licensed
Products for the Research Programs</U>. Avidity shall Manufacture (or have Manufactured) and supply to BMS Licensed Compounds (including Lead Compounds or Development Candidates, as applicable) and Licensed Products containing such Licensed
Compounds for use in the conduct of activities under the Research Programs. The supply requirements requested by BMS shall be set forth in the applicable Research Plan and the cost for such requirements shall be included in the applicable Research
Budget. For clarity, during the Research Term, Avidity will only Manufacture <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-GMP</FONT> Materials pursuant to this Section&nbsp;6.3.2; provided, however, that, upon BMS&#8217;s request, the Parties shall discuss
in good faith Avidity&#8217;s Manufacture and supply of GMP Materials to BMS where BMS determines (in BMS&#8217;s sole discretion) that comparability studies are required. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.3.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>Supply of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products following the Research Programs</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:16%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(a)&#8195;&#8194;If and to the extent requested by BMS, Avidity will Manufacture (or have Manufactured) and supply Licensed
Compounds (or Licensed Products containing such Licensed Compounds, as requested by BMS) (and placebo) Directed to the First Licensed Target for BMS&#8217;s use in clinical Development for Phase 1 Trials and Phase 2 Trials, following the completion
of the Research Program with respect thereto. However, if BMS desires for Avidity to Manufacture and supply such Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products (and placebo) for use in Phase 1 Trials or Phase 2 Trials, then BMS must provide to Avidity a
written request for such supply no later than the Successful Achievement of the Development Candidate Criteria with respect to such Research Program for the First Licensed Target. If so requested by BMS in accordance with this Section&nbsp;6.3.2
(Supply of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products), the Parties shall negotiate in good faith and shall enter into a supply agreement and associated quality agreement (collectively, the &#8220;<U>Supply Agreement</U>&#8221;), which shall include
customary provisions to address the forecasting, order, delivery, and other customary provisions applicable to the supply of such Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products for BMS&#8217;s such Development purposes; <I>provided</I> that Avidity will
not be required to Manufacture (or have Manufactured) and supply any Licensed Compounds or Licensed Products until the Parties have executed a Supply Agreement. Any supply pursuant to this Section&nbsp;6.3.3(a) (and for clarity, not provided
pursuant to Section&nbsp;6.3.2 (Supply of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products for the Research Programs) for use in the conduct of Research Collaboration Activities) shall be charged to BMS at Avidity&#8217;s actual fully-burdened cost of goods
plus a [***]% <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">mark-up.</FONT> In all cases, BMS shall have the right to review, and coordinate with Avidity with respect to, the supply chain to be used by Avidity to Manufacture and supply Development Candidates and
Licensed Products hereunder. Except as provided in this Section&nbsp;6.3.3(a), unless otherwise agreed by the Parties, BMS will be responsible for the Manufacture of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products for BMS&#8217;s use in Development
following the completion of the Research Program with respect thereto. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:16%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">(b)&#8195;&#8194;Notwithstanding the foregoing
provisions of this Section&nbsp;6.3.3 (Supply of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products following the Research Programs), upon written notice to Avidity, BMS shall have the right, in its discretion, on a Licensed <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Compound-by-Licensed</FONT></FONT> Compound or Licensed <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Product-by-Licensed</FONT></FONT> Product basis, as applicable, to take over responsibility for
Manufacturing (or having Manufactured) the applicable Licensed Compound or Licensed Product. If BMS provides such written notice, then BMS shall have full control, responsibility, and decision making authority in connection with such Manufacture and
supply (and, if requested by BMS, Avidity shall commence the Manufacturing technology transfers and provide such other assistance with respect to the Manufacture of the applicable Development Candidate or Licensed Product in accordance with
Section&nbsp;5.10 (Information Sharing to Enable Exploitation of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products) and Section&nbsp;6.4.2 (Manufacturing Technology Transfer)). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">34 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.4&#8195;&#8194;<U>Manufacturing Transition</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.4.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>Generally</U>. The JSC shall establish a joint technology transfer and supply steering committee
(&#8220;<U>JTTSSC</U>&#8221;) of duly qualified Manufacturing personnel to facilitate supply of, and development of the Avidity Manufacturing Process for, the relevant Licensed Compound and Licensed Products hereunder and Manufacturing Technology
Transfer. The JTTSSC will be responsible for monitoring the progress of the Research Collaboration Activities under the Research Plans to anticipate, and plan for, the transition of Manufacturing responsibilities for the Licensed Compounds and
Licensed Products to BMS. Avidity will regularly provide updates to the JTTSSC with respect to the status of the Manufacture and supply of, and development of the Avidity Manufacturing Process for, the relevant Licensed Compound and Licensed
Products. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.4.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Manufacturing Technology Transfer</U>. Without limiting the provisions of
Section&nbsp;5.10 (Information Sharing to Enable Exploitation of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products), on a Research <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Program-by-Research</FONT></FONT> Program basis, at the
request of BMS, Avidity shall provide, and shall use Commercially Reasonable Efforts to cause its Third Party manufacturers to provide to BMS (or its designee), a full manufacturing technology transfer (including providing assistance as reasonably
requested by BMS in connection with such transfer) of Avidity <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> to enable BMS (or its Affiliate or designated Third Party manufacturer, as applicable) to implement the Avidity Manufacturing Process for,
and to otherwise Manufacture, Licensed Products (including any Licensed Compound contained therein) from such Research Program at the facilities designated by BMS (each, a &#8220;<U>Manufacturing Technology Transfer</U>&#8221;). Prior to initiating
such Manufacturing Technology Transfer, the Parties (through the JTTSSC) will promptly develop and agree upon a plan for conducting such Manufacturing Technology Transfer, including a timeline for completing activities set forth therein (the
&#8220;<U>Manufacturing Technology Transfer Plan</U>&#8221;). Avidity shall initiate such requested Manufacturing Technology Transfer promptly (and in all cases within [***]) after the Manufacturing Technology Transfer Plan is agreed upon by the
Parties and shall complete such transfer in accordance with the Manufacturing Technology Transfer Plan on the timeline set forth therein. If requested by BMS, such Manufacturing Technology Transfer Plan shall include (a)&nbsp;facilitating BMS (or
its Affiliate) entering into agreements with applicable Third Party suppliers relating to Licensed Compounds or Licensed Products, and (b)&nbsp;Avidity (and its Affiliates and Third Party manufacturers) providing to BMS (or its Affiliate or
designated Third Party manufacturer, as applicable) all test results, records and other documentation related to the Manufacture of Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products, which shall be provided in English. Without limiting the generality of the
foregoing, until such time as BMS (or its designee) is able to Manufacture <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">GMP-grade</FONT> clinical quantities of the applicable Licensed Compound or Licensed Product, as applicable (the &#8220;<U>Manufacturing
Transition Period</U>&#8221;), (i) at the request of BMS, Avidity shall make available its (and its Affiliates&#8217;) employees (subject to the reasonable availability of such employees) and consultants (including using Commercially Reasonable
Efforts to cause personnel of its Third Party contract manufacturers to be made available) to BMS (and its designees) to provide reasonable consultation and technical assistance (including visitation to facilities) in order to assist with the
implementation of the Manufacture (including with respect to the Avidity Manufacturing Process) of such Licensed Compound and Licensed Product by BMS (or its designee) and to assist BMS (or its designee) in the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">start-up</FONT> of its Manufacture of such Licensed Compound and Licensed Product, as applicable, as well as Manufacturing process development for such Licensed Compound and Licensed Product and (ii)&nbsp;in addition
to the foregoing clause (i), at the request of BMS, [***]. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.4.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>Cost of Manufacturing Technology
Transfer</U>. With respect to the Manufacturing Technology Transfer and assistance provided under Section&nbsp;6.4.2 (Manufacturing Technology Transfer), Avidity will provide BMS with a cumulative maximum of [***] FTE hours at no charge and, once
such [***] FTE hours has been hit, BMS will pay Avidity for the FTE Costs of such Manufacturing Technology Transfer and assistance at a mutually agreed FTE Rate. In addition, BMS shall reimburse Avidity for all documented <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Out-of-Pocket</FONT></FONT> Costs incurred by Avidity in providing such support; <I>provided</I> that BMS must <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-approve</FONT> any individual <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Out-Of-Pocket</FONT></FONT> Cost that is not contemplated by the <U>Schedule 6.4.2</U> and exceeds [***]. BMS will reimburse to Avidity for the FTE Costs and
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Out-Of-Pocket</FONT></FONT> Costs set forth in this Section&nbsp;6.4.3 (Cost of Manufacturing Technology Transfer) within [***] of receiving an invoice therefor. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.5&#8195;&#8194;<U>Commercialization</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.5.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>General</U>. BMS (and its Affiliates), either itself or with or through Third Party(ies), shall have the
sole right to Commercialize (and shall control all aspects of the Commercialization of) Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products in the Field in the Territory, subject to the terms of this Agreement. Without limiting the foregoing, BMS (and its
Affiliates), either itself or with or through Third Party(ies), shall have the sole right to (a)&nbsp;invoice and book sales, establish all terms of sale (including pricing and discounts), warehouse and distribute the Licensed Products in the Field
in the Territory and to perform or cause to be performed all related services and (b)&nbsp;handle all returns, recalls, or withdrawals, order processing, invoicing, collection, distribution, and inventory management with respect to the Licensed
Products in the Field in the Territory. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.5.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Diligence</U>. Subject to Avidity&#8217;s compliance with
this Agreement, on a Licensed <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Target-by-Licensed</FONT></FONT> Target basis, BMS (itself or with or through its Affiliates or Third Parties) shall [***]. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.5.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>Licensed Product Trademarks</U>. BMS and its Affiliates shall have the sole right to use any Trademark
it owns or controls for Licensed Products in the Territory at its sole discretion. BMS shall have the sole right to control the name generation, selection, and clearance process relating to the creation of names and logos that become Licensed
Product Trademarks. BMS shall also have the sole right to prosecute, enforce, and defend one or more Licensed Product Trademark(s). As between the Parties, BMS and its Affiliates shall own all rights to such Licensed Product Trademarks and all
goodwill associated therewith, and the rights to any Internet domain names incorporating the applicable Licensed Product Trademarks or any variation or part of such Licensed Product Trademarks or the Licensed Product&#8217;s generic name used as its
URL address or any part of such address, throughout the Territory. Avidity shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates and (sub)licensees not to, (a)&nbsp;use in their respective businesses, any Trademark that is confusingly similar to, misleading or
deceptive with respect to or that dilutes any (or any part) of the Licensed Product Trademarks (other than nominative fair use of such License Product Trademarks), and (b) do any act that endangers, destroys, or similarly affects, in any material
respect, the value of the goodwill pertaining to the Licensed Product Trademarks. Avidity shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates and (sub)licensees not to, attack, dispute, or contest the validity of or ownership of any Licensed Product Trademark
anywhere in the Territory or any registrations issued or issuing with respect thereto. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.5.4&#8195;&#8194;<U>Avidity <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Co-Promotion</FONT> Discussion</U>. [***]. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">6.6&#8195;&#8194;<U>Development Reports</U>. On a
Research <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Program-by-Research</FONT></FONT> Program basis, following the end of the Research Term for such Research Program and until First Commercial Sale of a Licensed Product
Directed to the Licensed Target with respect to such Research Program, on a [***] basis, BMS shall provide Avidity with a high-level written summary of any material clinical Development activities resulting from BMS&#8217;s, its Affiliate&#8217;s or
Sublicensee&#8217;s clinical Development of applicable Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products under this Agreement (a)&nbsp;since the last written summary and (b)&nbsp;that are planned for the next [***]. All such information shall be Confidential
Information of BMS. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">ARTICLE 7. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><U>PAYMENTS; ROYALTIES AND REPORTS</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>Upfront Payment</U>. In consideration for the rights and licenses granted to BMS by Avidity under this
Agreement, BMS shall pay Avidity a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-time</FONT> payment in the amount of $60,000,000 within 30 days after the Effective Date (the &#8220;<U>Upfront Payment</U>&#8221;). The Upfront Payment will be nonrefundable
and noncreditable against any other payments due hereunder. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Equity Investment</U>. The Parties are
entering into the Securities Purchase Agreement as of the Effective Date pursuant to which BMS shall purchase certain shares of Common Stock of Avidity, all as set forth therein. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>Milestone Payments</U>. In consideration for the rights and licenses granted to BMS by Avidity under this
Agreement, BMS shall pay to Avidity the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-time,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-refundable,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-creditable</FONT> milestone payments set forth in this
Section&nbsp;7.3 (Milestone Payments) (collectively, &#8220;<U>Milestone </U><U>Payments</U>&#8221;) upon the first achievement of the corresponding milestone event set forth in this Section&nbsp;7.3 (Milestone Payments) (collectively,
&#8220;<U>Milestone Events</U>&#8221;), in each case within the period of time set forth herein. </P>

the first achievement hereunder by Licensed Products Directed to such Licensed Target in a given Calendar Year, whether Net Sales are made by BMS, its Affiliates or Sublicensees (each such sales milestone event, a &#8220;<U>Sales
Milestone</U>&#8221; and its corresponding milestone payment, a &#8220;<U>Sales Milestone Payment</U>&#8221;). Each Sales Milestone Payment shall be in accordance with the procedure set forth in Section&nbsp;7.3.3 (Notice of Event Milestone
Achievement). </P>

of the first Registrational Trial for a Licensed Product set forth in Section&nbsp;7.3.1(a) or Section&nbsp;7.3.1(b) has failed to be achieved and BMS (or any of its Affiliates or Sublicensees) achieves the first approval of Drug Approval
Application in U.S. with respect to the same Licensed Product then such Milestone Event shall be deemed achieved and BMS shall pay to Avidity the Milestone Payment corresponding to Initiation of the first Registrational Trial for a Licensed Product
set forth in Section&nbsp;7.3.1(a) or Section&nbsp;7.3.1(b), as applicable. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.4&#8195;&#8194;<U>Royalties</U>. </P>

particular Calendar Quarter, an amount equal to [***] of the amount of any such payments (including payments for obtaining such right or license, royalties, milestones and any other amounts) paid by BMS (or any of its Affiliates or Sublicensees) to
such Third Party for license (or the exercise thereof) (&#8220;<U>BMS Third Party Payments</U>&#8221;). </P>

payable by BMS for such Licensed Product in such country in any given [***] to less than [***] of the royalty amounts otherwise payable by BMS for such Licensed Product in such country in such [***]. BMS may carry over and apply any such royalty

Section&nbsp;7.4.6 (Cumulative Cap on Royalty Reductions). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.4.7&#8195;&#8194;<U>Compulsory Licenses</U>. If a Compulsory

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.5&#8195;&#8194;<U>Economics for
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-AOC</FONT> Licensed Compounds</U>. The Parties stipulate and agree that the economic terms reflected in this Agreement assume that all Licensed Compounds will be AOCs and that the value of any <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-AOC</FONT> platform technology that may in the future be developed by Avidity is not reflected in this Agreement. Accordingly, and notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, if BMS desires to include
in a Research Plan for a Licensed Target the research and Development of a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-AOC</FONT> compound Directed to such Licensed Target, then the Parties will discuss in good faith the additional economic terms that will
apply to such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-AOC</FONT> Licensed Compound to fairly compensate Avidity for the value that would be provide by such future <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-AOC</FONT> platform technology, and Avidity will
have no obligation to enter into such a Research Plan unless and until such additional economic terms have been agreed upon by the Parties and set forth in an amendment to this Agreement or other written agreement between the Parties. </P>

Agreement shall bear interest at an annual rate equal to the lesser of (a) [***], or (b)&nbsp;the highest rate permitted by Applicable Law, in each case calculated on the number of days such payment is delinquent, compounded monthly; except that,

the original date on which the disputed payment was due through the date on which payment is actually made. </P>

or illegal for BMS to transfer, or have transferred on its behalf, payments owed to Avidity hereunder, BMS will promptly notify Avidity of the conditions preventing such transfer and such payments will be deposited in local currency in the relevant

identified in a written notice given to Avidity. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.9&#8195;&#8194;<U>Audits</U>.<B>&nbsp;</B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.9.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>Audit Team</U>. Avidity may, upon Avidity&#8217;s request and at Avidity&#8217;s expense (except as
provided for herein), cause an internationally recognized independent accounting firm selected by Avidity (except one to whom BMS has a reasonable objection) (the &#8220;<U>Audit Team</U>&#8221;) to audit, during ordinary business hours, the books
and records of BMS and its Affiliates and the correctness of any payment made or required to be made, and any report underlying any such payment (or lack thereof), pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. Prior to commencing its work pursuant to
this Agreement, the Audit Team will enter into an appropriate confidentiality agreement with BMS obligating the Audit Team to be bound by obligations of confidentiality and restrictions on use of BMS&#8217;s Confidential Information that are no less
restrictive than the obligations set forth in Article 8 (Confidentiality and Publication). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.9.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Limitations</U>. In respect of each audit of BMS&#8217;s and its Affiliates&#8217; books and records:
(a)&nbsp;BMS and each of its Affiliates may be audited only once per Calendar Year, (b)&nbsp;no books and records for any given Calendar Year may be audited more than once, but BMS&#8217;s and its Affiliates&#8217; books and records shall still be
made available if such records impact another Calendar Year being audited, and (c)&nbsp;Avidity shall only be entitled to audit books and records of BMS from the three Calendar Years prior to the Calendar Year in which the audit request is made.

provide written notice of such audit to BMS. Avidity shall provide BMS with notice of one or more proposed dates of the audit not less than [***] prior to the first proposed date. BMS shall, and shall ensure that its Affiliates, reasonably
accommodate the scheduling of such audit. BMS shall, and shall ensure that its Affiliates, provide the Audit Team(s) with full access to the applicable books and records and otherwise reasonably cooperate with such audit. </P>

under-reporting, underpayment or overpayment shall be reported to Avidity, </P>

(Tax Matters) are reduced to the fullest extent permitted by Applicable Law. Notwithstanding the foregoing, BMS shall not withhold or deduct amounts without providing commercially reasonable notice and the opportunity to provide necessary
certifications to reduce or eliminate such withholding or deductions. In addition, the Parties shall cooperate to minimize withholding taxes and indirect taxes (such as value added tax, sales tax, consumption tax and other similar taxes) in
connection with this Agreement, as applicable. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">7.10.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Taxes Resulting from BMS Action</U>. If, as a

&#8220;<U>Withholding Tax Action</U>&#8221;), BMS is required by Applicable Law to withhold taxes that would not have otherwise been due hereunder with respect to payments under this Agreement, then BMS shall pay additional amounts (including with
respect to deductions and withholding on such amounts) to the extent necessary to ensure that Avidity receives a net amount equal to the sum that Avidity would have received had no such Withholding Tax Action occurred. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">ARTICLE 8. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><U>CONFIDENTIALITY AND
PUBLICATION </U></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.1&#8195;&#8194;<U>Confidential Information</U>. &#8220;<U>Confidential Information</U>&#8221; means any
data, information or material disclosed by one Party (the &#8220;<U>Disclosing Party</U>&#8221;) in writing, visually, orally or in electronic medium to the other Party (the &#8220;<U>Receiving Party</U>&#8221;) under this Agreement. Except as
expressly set forth herein, the terms of this Agreement shall be the Confidential Information of both Parties (with each Party being deemed to be the Receiving Party with respect thereto) and both Parties shall have the obligations set forth in this
Article 8 (Confidentiality and Publication) with respect thereto. In addition, the Parties agree and acknowledge that, in all cases, all BMS Contributed Collaboration Technology, BMS Contributed Collaboration Inventions, BMS Sole Inventions, BMS
Manufacturing <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Know-How</FONT> (to the extent any is disclosed to Avidity), and the identity of the Licensed Targets are the Confidential Information of BMS, and the Avidity AOC Platform Technology and the Avidity
Manufacturing Process are the Confidential Information of Avidity. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.2&#8195;&#8194;<U>Product Information</U>.
Notwithstanding Section&nbsp;8.1 (Confidential Information), Avidity recognizes that by reason of, <I>inter alia</I>, BMS&#8217;s status as an exclusive licensee pursuant to the grants under Section&nbsp;5.1.1(a) (License Grant), BMS has an interest
in Avidity&#8217;s maintaining the confidentiality of certain information of Avidity and certain information of both Parties. Accordingly, during the Term, Avidity shall, and shall cause its Affiliates and its and their respective officers,
directors, employees, and agents to, keep confidential, and not publish, disclose, or use for any purpose (other than to fulfill Avidity&#8217;s obligations, or exercise Avidity&#8217;s rights (including all rights retained by Avidity) hereunder),
any [***], collectively, the &#8220;<U>Product Information</U>&#8221;), except to the extent (i)&nbsp;the Product Information is in the public domain through no fault of Avidity, its Affiliates or any of its or their respective officers, directors,
employees, or agents, (ii)&nbsp;disclosure of the Product Information is expressly permitted under Section&nbsp;8.5 (Permitted Disclosures), or (iii)&nbsp;such disclosure or use is otherwise expressly permitted by the terms of this Agreement (which,
for clarity, shall be interpreted as if Avidity was the Receiving Party with respect thereto). For purposes of Section&nbsp;8.3 (Nondisclosure Obligation) and Section&nbsp;8.5 (Permitted Disclosures), BMS shall be deemed to be the disclosing Party
with respect to Product Information under Section&nbsp;8.3 (Nondisclosure Obligation) and Section&nbsp;8.5 (Permitted Disclosures) and Avidity shall be deemed to be the receiving Party with respect thereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.3&#8195;&#8194;<U>Nondisclosure Obligation</U>. Subject to Section&nbsp;8.4 (Exceptions) and Section&nbsp;8.5 (Permitted
Disclosure), unless the Disclosing Party provides prior written consent, the Receiving Party shall maintain in confidence all Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party using at least the same degree of care with which the Receiving Party
holds its own confidential information (but in no event less than a commercially reasonable degree of care), shall not disclose such Confidential Information to any Third Party and shall not use such Confidential Information for any purpose except
to exercise such Party&#8217;s rights or fulfill its obligations under this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.4&#8195;&#8194;<U>Exceptions</U>.
Each Party&#8217;s confidentiality and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-use</FONT> obligations under this Agreement shall not apply to any portion of the Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party that the Receiving Party can demonstrate
with competent written proof: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.4.1&#8195;&#8194;is known by the Receiving Party at the time of its receipt, without
obligation of confidentiality or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-use,</FONT> and not through a prior disclosure by the Disclosing Party; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.4.2&#8195;&#8194;is in the public domain before its receipt from the Disclosing Party, or thereafter enters the public
domain through no fault of the Receiving Party or with the consent of the Disclosing Party; </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">44 </P>

or to gain or maintain authorizations to conduct Clinical Trials or to market Licensed Products; <I>provided</I> that such disclosure is limited to the extent reasonably necessary to obtain such patents or authorizations and the Receiving Party
takes reasonable measures to obtain confidential treatment from regulatory agencies for such information; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.5.2&#8195;&#8194;is made to (a)&nbsp;the Receiving Party&#8217;s Affiliates, potential and actual Sublicensees (with respect
to BMS), employees, officers, directors, agents, consultants, or other Third Parties for purposes the Receiving Party reasonably deems necessary or advisable for the exploitation of its rights (including its retained rights) or fulfillment of its
obligations under this Agreement, or (b)<I>&nbsp;bona fide</I> potential or actual acquirors, investors, financing sources (including in any potential royalty financing), strategic partners, royalty purchasers, and their counsel (<I>provided</I>
that, in each case, disclosure by Avidity as the Receiving Party of Confidential Information under this clause (b)&nbsp;shall be (A)&nbsp;limited[***] and (B)&nbsp;on a need to know basis as may be necessary in connection with their evaluation of
such potential acquisition, investment, or collaboration); <I>provided</I> that, in each case ((a) and (b)), (i) all such recipients agree to be bound by, or are otherwise bound by, confidentiality and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-use</FONT>
obligations that are no less stringent than those confidentiality and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-use</FONT> provisions contained in this Agreement and obligations of invention assignment sufficient for such Party to obtain rights from such
personnel to meet its obligation to grant licenses to the other Party under this Agreement and (ii)&nbsp;the Receiving Party shall be responsible for and liable under this Agreement with respect to any breach of its confidentiality and <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-use</FONT> obligations caused by such recipients; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:10%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.5.3&#8195;&#8194;is required to comply
with Applicable Law, valid order of a court of competent jurisdiction, or other judicial or administrative process of governmental authority or agency, including of the United States Securities and Exchange Commission or similar regulatory agency in
other countries; <I>provided</I> that the Receiving Party shall (a)&nbsp;promptly inform the Disclosing Party of the disclosure that is being sought in order to provide the Disclosing Party, where possible, an opportunity to challenge, limit or
receive confidential treatment for the required disclosure, (b)&nbsp;upon request, reasonably cooperate with any efforts by the Disclosing Party to challenge, limit, or receive confidential treatment for, the required disclosure, and (c)&nbsp;only
disclose the minimum Confidential Information necessary to comply, as determined by the Receiving Party&#8217;s legal counsel. Confidential Information or Product Information that is disclosed by judicial or administrative process, or through
operation of Applicable Law or rules of a securities exchange shall remain otherwise subject to the confidentiality and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-use</FONT> provisions set forth in this Article 8 (Confidentiality and Publication) unless
released into the public domain through such process or operation of Applicable Law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:8pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:5%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">8.6&#8195;&#8194;<U>Survival</U>.

Section&nbsp;8.9 for which Avidity has the right to comment, BMS shall provide a copy of the proposed publication (including abstracts, or presentation to a journal, editor, meeting, seminar or other third party) to Avidity for at least [***] prior
